sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: Legend, native label, description and error are text with explicit IDs. Orientation and error styling supplement these relations.
updatesAndDescendants: Field is role=group; FieldSet/Legend are native fieldset/legend. FieldError renders nothing without content, gives explicit children precedence over errors, deduplicates errors by message, and otherwise renders one message or a list with role=alert. It does not validate inputs or associate error IDs automatically.
referenceDecision: This reference supplies label-for and describedby IDs and requires readable error messages. Validation remains caller-owned. Group keyboard behavior comes from the child Input rather than a fabricated Field state machine.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
